preprocessing: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown=ignore, sparse_output=False) fitted on training rows only; numeric columns passed through; no salary imputation.
selection_rule: One fixed configuration; no test-set tuning, threshold selection, resampling or best-of-seed selection.
artifact_rule: Persist the same pipeline fitted on the 172 training rows and evaluated on the 43 held-out rows; do not refit on the test set.
integration_gate: Report metrics to the user before frontend integration. This milestone does not change API/profile schema or frontend.
